 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Ninth place Santos FC take on Coritiba as they look to secure a Copa Libertadores qualification spot with only four matches left this season. Cuca's side are winless in their last three fixtures and are coming off a 2-1 loss against Bragantino. 
 They take on Coritiba who are ranked 13th in the table with 42 points and are also looking to bounce back after a 1-0 loss against Internacional. Interim boss Guilherme Bossle is looking to steady the ship but the side only won one in their last five matches, making a positive result tonight very important for Glorioso.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Is Neymar Playing Tonight?
 Neymar was sent off against Bahia after the winger was caught covering his mouth during an on-field argument with Rodrigo Nestor. The 34-year-old was given a 2-match suspension and is now available for selection and is expected to start tonight.
 SANTOS, BRAZIL – SEPTEMBER 2: Neymar fights for the ball with Murilo during the Copa do Brasil 2026 Quarter-final match between Santos and Palmeiras.Photo by Ricardo Moreira/Getty Images)
 Along with Neymar, Cuca is also boosted by the return of numerous players including Willian Arão, Escobar, Thaciano and João Schmidt.
 Santos vs. Coritiba Lineups
 Coritiba Predicted lineup:
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Goalkeeper: Rangel
 Defenders: Tinga, Tiago Coser, Moledo, B. Melo
 Midfielders: Gomez, Santos, Lavega, Josue, Lopes
 Forward: Rocha 
 Santos Predicted lineup:
 Goalkeeper: Diogenes
 Defenders: Rodinei, Arao, Peres, Escobar
 Midfielders: Henrique, Oliva, Coutinho, Neymar, Everton
 Forward: Barbosa
 Santos vs. Coritiba Head-to-Head
 Historically, Santos holds a clear lead over Coritiba with six wins and two draws in their last ten encounters. 
 However, in 2026, the results between the two sides have been far more competitive. While Peixe eliminated Coritiba 2-0 on aggregate in the Copa do Brasil fifth round earlier this year, Coritiba defeated Santos with a 3-0 away victory in their earlier league meeting.
 Start Time & How to Watch Santos vs. Coritiba
 The match kicks off tonight at 5:30 PM EST in the USA and 7:30 PM BRT in Brazil.
